title: Tag icons, tab arranging, Switch 2 emulators

cards.title: Tag icons
cards.body:
*Tag icons* (Supporter Pack). Tabs can show an icon instead of their name. Built-in tabs, genres, stores and emulated consoles each come with one, and the Wall theme shows them on its row labels.

Choose how tabs look in [MENU]*Settings > Visuals > General > Tab labels*: names, icons, icons with names, or icons with the active tab’s name.

To change a tag’s icon, press [X] on it in [MENU]*Settings > Library > Tag Manager*. Pick a built-in icon, use your own image from a link or a file, or choose no icon.

cards.title: Better navigation flow
cards.body:
*Rearrange tabs*. Press [LB] and [RB] together to grab the current tab, move it with [DPAD] left or right, then press [LB] and [RB], [A] or [B] to let go. Works on the Installed tabs, in Settings and in the game menu.

*Jump to the ends*. [LT] and [RT] jump to the first and last item in every grid and menu.

Moving through the grid is smoother too: very large logos and artwork are scaled down once and kept.

cards.title: Upgraded emulator support
cards.body:
*Switch 2 emulators*. Eglantine, Lichii and Fritchii are detected, along with NUP, NX, NSZ and XCZ dumps. Update and DLC files are folded into the game they belong to.

*Run with*. Pick the emulator for one game in the game menu > Tools > Run with, and press [Y] there to make it the console’s default. Defaults per console are also in [MENU]*Settings > Library > Emulators*.

When a game uses a different emulator than its console’s default, the launch popup offers both: [A] launches with the game’s own, [Y] once with the default.

Emulated games now get genre tags automatically too.

changelog: New: *Tag icons* (Supporter Pack). Tabs can show an icon instead of their name. Choose it in Settings > Visuals > General > Tab labels: names, icons, icons with names, or icons with the active tab's name.

New: pick the icon of any tag. In the Tag Manager, press X on a tag to open the icon picker (Supporter Pack). Choose from the built-in icons, use your own image from a link or a file, or pick *no icon* to keep a tab as text.

New: *Rearrange tabs*. Press LB and RB together to grab the current tab, move it with left or right on the D-pad, then press LB and RB, A, or B to let go. Works on the Installed tabs, in Settings, and in the game menu.
New: LT and RT jump to the first and last item in EVERY grid and menu.
New: *Switch 2 emulators*. Eglantine, Lichii and Fritchii are detected, along with NUP, NX, NSZ and XCZ dumps.
New: *Run with* (game menu > Tools) picks the emulator for one game. Press Y there to make it the console's default, or set defaults per console in Settings > Library > Emulators.
New: the launch popup shows which emulator will run the game. If a game uses a different emulator than its console's default, press Y to launch it once with the default.
New: *Open emulator folder* in the game menu > Tools of an emulated game.
New: emulated games get genre tags automatically, like the games from stores.
New: in the Custom sound set (Supporter Pack), X mutes a slot and Y plays it.
The Wall theme shows the same icons on its row labels.
Tag Manager: show or hide a tag with left or right on the D-pad. X now opens the icon picker.
Smoother grid navigation: very large logos and artwork are scaled down once and kept.
Fixed the left stick stepping two tiles from one push, and the right stick skipping columns on the top row of 360x.
Steam tiles now show only up-to-date download progress, and mark paused updates.
Updated naming logic for Nintendo Switch games.
Fixed a press of A in the launch popup being ignored now and then.
Fixed a game's logo being replaced by its title for good after it failed to load once.
Several other bug fixes, performance improvements, and UI polish.

id.*Tag icons* (Supporter Pack). Tabs can s:
*Ikon tag* (Supporter Pack). Tab bisa tampil sebagai ikon, bukan nama. Tab bawaan, genre, toko, dan konsol emulasi masing-masing sudah punya ikon, dan tema Wall menampilkannya di label barisnya.

Atur tampilan tab di [MENU]*Pengaturan > Tampilan > Umum > Label tab*: nama, ikon, ikon dengan nama, atau ikon dengan nama tab yang aktif.

Untuk mengganti ikon tag, tekan [X] pada tag itu di [MENU]*Pengaturan > Library > Tag Manager*. Pilih ikon bawaan, pakai gambarmu sendiri dari link atau file, atau pilih tanpa ikon.
id.*Rearrange tabs*. Press [LB] and [RB] to:
*Atur urutan tab*. Tekan [LB] dan [RB] bersamaan untuk memegang tab yang sedang aktif, geser dengan [DPAD] kiri atau kanan, lalu tekan [LB] dan [RB], [A], atau [B] untuk melepasnya. Berlaku di tab Terinstal, di Pengaturan, dan di menu game.

*Lompat ke ujung*. [LT] dan [RT] melompat ke item pertama dan terakhir di semua grid dan menu.

Navigasi grid juga lebih mulus: logo dan artwork yang sangat besar diperkecil sekali lalu disimpan.
id.*Switch 2 emulators*. Eglantine, Lichii:
*Emulator Switch 2*. Eglantine, Lichii, dan Fritchii terdeteksi, beserta dump NUP, NX, NSZ, dan XCZ. File update dan DLC digabung ke game pemiliknya.

*Jalankan pakai*. Pilih emulator untuk satu game di menu game > Tools > Jalankan pakai, lalu tekan [Y] di sana untuk menjadikannya default konsol itu. Default per konsol juga ada di [MENU]*Pengaturan > Library > Emulator*.

Kalau game memakai emulator yang berbeda dari default konsolnya, popup launch menawarkan keduanya: [A] menjalankan dengan emulator game itu, [Y] sekali dengan emulator default.

Game emulasi sekarang juga otomatis mendapat tag genre.
